provenance.notes: Combined pages cover -1205 through 1104966 ms. Omitted 5 canceled casts, 2 pre-pull actions (Toxikon II and Psyche), and 29 utility/item actions (Sprint, Swiftcast, Lucid Dreaming, Grade 4 Gemdraught of Mind [HQ]) using the existing SGE catalog scope. Consolidated 7 paired Pneuma entries by retaining each earlier cast timestamp, including the pair across the page boundary. Practice starts at Kardia (536 ms). Report code, fight ID, rank, patch, and fight date are not provided by the CSVs.
